uncited: Applies the same rank $(R, R, R)$ to all blocks.
Simple to implement but inefficient for heterogeneous data. [Link](7540-truncated-tensor-decomposition.md) discusses the general concept of rank reduction.
Uses information entropy to determine block resolution.
*   **Time Complexity:** The preprocessing time is higher than uniform high-rank decomposition.
*   **Memory Complexity:** The memory usage is dominated by the storage of the high-rank factor matrices and core tensor for all blocks.
*   **Compression Ratio:** The adaptive method achieves a significantly better compression ratio than uniform high-rank decomposition.
